name: PM-KISAN
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi - Direct income support to farmers
applicationProcess: Online through PM-KISAN portal or CSC centers

name: Ayushman Bharat
description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana - Health insurance scheme
benefits: Health coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
applicationProcess: Visit nearest Ayushman Bharat center with documents

name: PM Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship for children of armed forces and paramilitary personnel
benefits: ₹2500 per month for boys, ₹3000 per month for girls
applicationProcess: Online application through National Scholarship Portal

name: MUDRA Loan Scheme
description: Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency - Loans for small businesses
benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh for business development
applicationProcess: Apply through banks or MUDRA portal

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Savings scheme for girl child education and marriage
benefits: High interest rate savings account with tax benefits
applicationProcess: Open account at post office or authorized banks
